content.comment_body: I'm working on a solution using [product_name] and [product_name] modules to maintain real-time GPS tracking for a vehicle. Is it feasible to set this up so that the system sends location coordinates to a computer every 5 seconds, enabling live map updates? I understand that it's possible to store GPS data and retrieve it manually, but I'm aiming for automated data transfer at regular intervals, using a GPS and radio antenna. Thanks.
Consider reviewing this example from [company_name]: Monitoring and Control with the [product_name] Module.

I've already reviewed that example — in it, GPS data is saved in the [product_name] memory, and afterwards you can manually access and read the memory. It doesn't offer automatic or remote data transmission, plus you must have the [product_name] physically connected to your computer for the solution to work. I'm looking to access the location data remotely and automatically at intervals of about every 5 seconds.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is searching for a way to transmit GPS data from [product_name] modules to a remote computer at frequent intervals, supporting real-time map display. Current solutions and documentation detail only manual extraction of stored data, with no built-in capability for automated or remote streaming. This reveals a gap between existing product features and the need for seamless real-time tracking, especially regarding automated data transfer and compatibility with external mapping applications.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the equipment to offer automated, remote, and frequent transmission of GPS coordinates for real-time mapping, without needing manual involvement or a continuous physical connection to a computer.
